groups.rationale: Reviewed the callback replay guard, generated-fixture repairs and Windows browser URI probe correction against unchanged domains and deployment topology. The reference records bounded 23-test timing, healthy public-field rollout and ordinary Windows CLI observations while preserving native matrix, isolation and recovery gaps; physical placement and ledger authority are unchanged.

Documented the explicit non-nil GitHub callback attempt guard restoring invalid_callback with unchanged state, login, generation, phase and expiry fences under ADR-0202/0186. Pins and Teams now isolate every generated case and replay while retaining 100-case oracles; the 23-test timing-only pass does not qualify finite deadlines. Only Pins ordered-set receives 600000ms; module 300000ms, SQL ownership 120000ms and Teams 60000ms remain. Stable forced typing and the full normal Marshall gate are pending.

No shared protocol source, wire shape or consumer authority changed in this checkpoint. The callback guard and per-case test fixtures preserve existing contracts; reference timing and healthy CLI observations do not upgrade protocol, browser, native isolation or recovery acceptance.

No provisioner source or host-local authority changed in this checkpoint. The reference adds a bounded healthy inventory and ordinary Windows CLI observation while retaining earlier Lilly execution scope and the open native storage, isolation and recovery requirements; no new provisioner acceptance is claimed.

No service runtime or catalog source changed in this checkpoint. The reference records the separate three-test Porsche catalog regression and existing Marshall catalog structure check, with linguistic, packaged browser and native acceptance still separate; service ownership and transport boundaries are unchanged.

Reviewed the Windows browser probe folder query correction from a drive-letter filesystem path to a remote URI path. Exact workspace and native command assertions, production admission and authorization are unchanged. The harness build and whole-repository Python Ruff format, Ruff and ty gates passed; native retry ended before readiness and the handbook retains its browser and exact-image qualification gaps.

Reviewed the callback source, generated fixtures, targeted Pins budget and probe URI diff. The matrix review and reference distinguish 23 timing-only passes from pending finite-deadline full Marshall verification and pending stable typing, separate healthy rollout and strict-trust ordinary CLI observation from editor acceptance, and preserve catalog, native image, isolation and recovery gaps. Existing ADR-0202/0186 and ADR-0191 are restored without a new architecture decision.
